note: What tools/personalize.mjs changes on a customer's copy of THIS template from their questionnaire answers (seed/questions.json). Five kinds, and the difference between them is what may be INVENTED: `identity` is the customer's own words, written exactly (an answer they did not give keeps the template's value as a placeholder, named in the report under `unanswered`: the rules marked `unanswered: keep-demo` — the address, the phone, the e-mail, the footer and the Location card — say so; only a rule with an `empty` value empties its field); `replace` rewrites the demo brand everywhere it appears; `copy` is prose a model writes for their sector, with the demo text as the length-and-register reference; `rewrite` does the same for whole demo entries; `facts` are CLAIMS about a real business — counts, founding years, certifications, named clients, prices — and those are REMOVED, never written, because a made-up "380 projects since 2004" is a lie in the customer's name. `hide` unpublishes pages that are nothing but claims and drops their menu items. Values use {name} {NAME} {initials} {phone} {address} {year} {sector}; a rule whose value needs an answer the customer did not give is skipped and reported, never guessed.

brand.note: Where the customer's brand pictures go (tools/personalize.mjs writeBrand, from the kit's brand PR; a tool without it ignores this block): the light or only logo to core settings.logo, the favicon to core settings.favicon, and the dark-background logo to the image field below, made on the site when its schema has none. Name the chrome entry the header and footer read (references/brand-and-pages.md).
